messages:
maria: morning team — final clearance triage for Realtime v2. want a concise GA checklist we can sign off on today. items: SLA baseline, oncall coverage, runbook links, monitoring gates, pricing pilot, public docs. assign owners and call time for signoff.

jasper: i'll own SLA baselines + model fallback policy. proposing: p95 < 350ms, p99 < 900ms for cross-region, availability >= 99.9% measured daily. fallback: route to compact model at any latency or error spike.

zoe: ops will take rollout/playbook. need a 72h oncall schedule, runbook with exact rollback steps, and canary plan: 5% for 2h, 25% for 6h, then 100% if stable. who approves the final 100% cutover?

emily: support lead here — i'll draft customer-facing incident expectations and Tier1 triage. pilot customers get 12h ack, enterprise tiers per SLA doc. also need templates for customer comms and status page entries.

sami: docs will produce two pieces: internal runbook (debug checklist + logs to collect) and public launch notes (FAQ + migration guide). request: eng provide 4 reproducible failure cases and example traces.

finance: pricing: will propose a temporary pilot tier (6 weeks) with a fixed per-minute/response rate. need sample usage profile for 3 pilot customers to model revenue impact. also confirm billing metric: we'll keep per-token for now, but we need to support per-response later.

maria: good. owners recap: SLA=f;;; jasper, ops=zoe, docs=sami, support=emily, pricing=finance. target: owners post PRs to product repo by EOD.

jasper: small monitoring ask: add synthetic latency test that hits warm and cold paths every 2m. if synthetic p95 > 400ms for 10m -> page. i'll add Prometheus rules and a Grafana panel. example alert:
```
ALERT RealtimeV2_Synthetic_P95
IF histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(synth_req_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.4
FOR 10m
LABELS {severity="page"}
```

zoe: ops will wire that into runbook. also need capacity reservation: ops requests locking 16 GPUs for first 48h of GA and +10% headroom. who's signing the infra cost?

finance: finance can approve short-term reservation for pilot but needs CEO/CTO OK for extended commit. will draft cost note.

maria: decide on telemetry gating: must have dashboards for latency, errors, throughput, cache hit rate, and billing counters before we flip GA. any gaps?

jasper: cache hit rate metric missing on prod today — adding KV_hit_ratio metric and dashboards. also instrument model-variant routing so we can count fallback events.

emily: support playbooks: include severity mapping, sample questions, immediate actions (collect logs + request id), and escalation path to eng oncall. i'll write email and Slack templates.

sami: publishing plan: internal runbook + public notes go live when PR merges. also plan an internal 30-minute demo for CS and Sales. suggest Fri 09:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by @zoe for Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC — automated promotions enabled.

zoe: quick note on rollback: runbook step 3 -> flip traffic routing, step 4 -> rollback model stack, step 5 -> redeploy previous config. will document exact kube/traffic CLI commands.

maria: acceptance criteria for signoff: (1) alerts in place and tested, (2) runbook linked from alerts, (3) oncall rota + staffing confirmed for first 72h, (4) pricing pilot PR filed, (5) docs merged, (6) smoke synthetic green for 24h. any objections?

jasper: one ask: include a short post-launch validation checklist for first 48h (top customers, token burn, error spikes, latency deltas). i'll add it to the runbook.

emily: agree — include a customer-checklist and communication cadence (0h/6h/24h/48h updates).

finance: target to post pilot pricing PR by 18:00 UTC today. will include migration note and sample invoices.

sami: docs draft ready by 14:00 UTC, will request review from eng and support.

maria: excellent — final sync in 2h to confirm PR links. if all green we'll do the GA handshake tomorrow morning. thanks everyone. :rocket:
